dct_creator_sm: Burg, Theresa (University of Lethbridge, University of Lethbridge). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5096-3479
dct_description_sm:
Microsatellite datasets from black-browed (and Campbell), grey-headed and wandering (wandering, Tristan, Gibson's and antipodes) albatrosses.
List of primer names, sources, PCR conditions, etc are all provided in the publications listed above.  Burg, T. M. (2000). Genetic analyses of albatrosses: mating systems, population structure and taxonomy.  PhD thesis University of Cambridge will have everything in one document.
Blood, tissue or feather samples were collected/provided by a number of people including: British Antarctic Survey (Chris Hill), Deon Nel, Janet Kelso, Department of Conservation New Zealand (Jacinda Amey, Gus McAllister, Sherly Hamilton, Alan Wiltshire, Kath Walker, Graeme Elliot), Peter Moore, Henri Weimerskirch, Nic Huin, Graham Robertson, Paulo Catry.

Primers were designed from 31 of the microsatellite sequences. PCR reactions were carried out in 10 mL reaction volumes containing 1x thermalase reaction buffer (100 mM Tris (pH 8.3), 500 mM KCl, 1.5 mM MgCl2, 0.1% Tween 20, 0.1% gelatin, 0.1% NP40), 0.1 mM dGTP, 0.1 mM dATP, 0.1 mM dTTP, 0.01 mM dCTP, 8 pmol of each primer, 1% formamide, 60 mM TMAC, 0.25 U Taq polymerase (Promega) and 0.1 mCi [a32P]-dCTP. The only exception is the reaction mix used for locus De11 [NK buffer (67 mM Tris (pH 8), 160 mM (NH4)2SO4, 50 mM KCl, 1.5 mM MgCl2, 0.1% Tween 20 and no TMAC or formamide]. All loci were amplified using a two-step annealing procedure: one cycle for 2 min at 94C, 45 s at TA1, 50 s at 72C; seven cycles of 50 s at 94C, 45 s at TA1, 50 s at 72C; 25 cycles of 50 s at 89C, 45 s at TA2, 50 s at 72C; and one final cycle of 5 min at 72C. The two annealing temperatures (TA1 and TA2) are specific for each primer set and listed in Burg (1999).

dct_title_s: Albatross microsatellite dataset containing genotype data for: black-browed, grey-headed, Campbell, Antipodean and wandering albatross.
